svg.title: XPFC free energy with all local polynomial terms and the full nonlocal two-point density correlation integral.
svg.desc: LaTeX source \begin{aligned}\mathcal F[\psi]={}&\int d\bm r\left[\frac12\psi^2-\frac{\omega}{6}\psi^3+\frac{u}{12}\psi^4\right]\\&-\frac12\iint d\bm r\,d\bm r^{\prime}\,\psi(\bm r)C_2(|\bm r-\bm r^{\prime}|)\psi(\bm r^{\prime})\end{aligned}
